question_en:
I am a middle school art teacher and want to design a pre-class observation route on "Figures and Narratives in Public Art" based on the City of Rio Rancho's "Rio Rancho Public Art Guide." Using the range of all formal artwork entries in the main catalog from Chaco Rising to Power of the Spirit, please answer:

Reviewing the artwork photos for each entry in the catalog, which artworks themselves clearly depict at least one complete, recognizable human figure? Patterns showing only faces or masks, anthropomorphic animals, and small color patches that cannot be reliably identified as human figures do not count as hits. Please provide a complete list covering all formal entries in catalog order, stating the artwork name and the determination of "Hit" or "Miss" for each line; then, in the same order, list all hit works and their count.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of "Artwork Name—Determination" (in catalog order), followed by a Q&A section listing all hit works and their count in the same order.
